Product Features

  • 【Ergonomic & Comfortable】This rocking chair features an ergonomic design that includes a high backrest and properly positioned armrests for great comfort and relaxation. Say goodbye to back pain caused by sitting for long periods of time.
  • 【SIDE POCKET】 The rocking chair has a deep side pocket that makes it easy to store magazines and other essentials. This striped, multi-colored chair is a versatile addition to any workspace.
  • 【Color Selection】: This armchair is made of three interconnected colors, with a gradation from beige to sea blue, which gives the armchair a high-quality and elegant look
  • 【Stable and Durable Construction】The children's room rocking chair features a wooden surface and metal frame for reliable and stable support. It can carry up to 100 kg and provides stable support for gentle rocking on quiet nights.
  • 【Chair Size】 Chair overall size: 83 * 65.5 * 95cm (length x width x height); Thickness of 10cm, Seat Size: 46*46*60cm (Seat Depth x Seat Width x Seat Height); Stirrup size: 37*57*37cm (length x width x height), thickness of 6cm
  • 【Wide Range of Uses】Its compact size and versatile design make it a great choice for any home, office, or daycare center.
  • 【High Quality Material】The upholstered armchair is made of soft bouclé fabric. This elegant piece will bring a soft touch and elegance to your space.
  • 【Durability】It is durable and will not fade, wrinkle or warp even after prolonged use. Not to forget the high backrest, which provides sufficient support for your back.
  • 【EASY TO ASSEMBLE】We provide all the necessary hardware and tools, as well as an installation guide with wiring diagrams to help you assemble this rocking chair.
  • 【High Back Rocking Chair】This rocking chair is designed with a 60cm high backrest, which provides adequate support for your back and neck, and you can rest your head on it for extra comfort. The armrests help to relax your arms.

Descriptions

Description

This rocking chair is equipped with a 60 cm high backrest that provides adequate support for your back and neck, and on which you can rest your head for extra comfort. The armrests can help relax your arms. This children's bouncer is made of high-quality boucle fabric. This fabric is both skin-friendly and comfortable. The extremely design-oriented color scheme and smooth lines make this rocking accent chair very stylish and unique. Our unique rocking chair is designed for relaxation and comfort. We have designed a new high backrest that makes the rocking chair both aesthetic and comfortable. The thick seat cushion is filled with sponge, which is soft, comfortable, flexible and not easy to collapse. Our nursing chair combines reliability and comfort with a sturdy metal and wood frame for excellent stability. With a weight capacity of up to 100 kg, solid wooden legs and floor-friendly feet, this chair is built to last, so you can spend countless relaxing moments. We supply all the necessary parts and tools.
